agents.name: Gateway Orchestrator
agents.description: Entry node of the recovery graph: classifies a robot's failure as a UI exception or escalates it to a human.

arguments.name: task_name
arguments.description: Name of the task being recovered.

arguments.name: platform
arguments.description: Execution platform where the task runs.

arguments.name: os
arguments.description: Operating system where recovery is happening.

arguments.name: variables
arguments.description: Dictionary of runtime variables at error time.

arguments.name: ui_log
arguments.description: Ordered UI execution history leading up to the failure.

arguments.name: errored_act
arguments.description: Structured information about the action that failed.

arguments.name: model
arguments.description: Process model, in BPMN XML or another textual format, whose task ids are the model event ids that model_event_id refers to.

output_model.name: GatewayDecision
output_model.description: The gateway's classification of a failure, which routes the recovery.

fields.name: ui_exception
fields.description: Whether the failure is a UI interaction or UI state failure that acting on the robot's desktop can recover.

fields.name: rationale
fields.description: The evidence from the robot's report behind the classification.

agents.name: Recovery Inferer
agents.description: Infers what a UI recovery must achieve from the robot's report: the kind of failure, where it happened in the process model and the task for the GUI agent.

arguments.name: task_name
arguments.description: Name of the task being recovered.

arguments.name: platform
arguments.description: Execution platform where the task runs.

arguments.name: os
arguments.description: Operating system where recovery is happening.

arguments.name: variables
arguments.description: Runtime variables relevant to the task.

arguments.name: ui_log
arguments.description: Ordered UI execution history leading up to the failure.

arguments.name: errored_act
arguments.description: Structured information about the action that failed.

arguments.name: model
arguments.description: Process model, in BPMN XML or another textual format, whose task ids are the model event ids that model_event_id refers to.

output_model.name: RecoveryInference
output_model.description: What a UI recovery must achieve, inferred from the robot's report.

fields.name: failure_kind
fields.description: The kind of interaction that failed.

fields.name: failed_model_event_id
fields.description: The task id of `model` the failed activity performed; null when it can't be told.

fields.name: loop_passes
fields.description: 0-based pass of each loop enclosing the failed activity, outermost first; [] when it is in no loop.

fields.name: recovery_task
fields.description: The instruction for the GUI agent: the state the application must reach.

fields.name: rationale
fields.description: Why this task gets the process back on track.

agents.name: UI Exception Handler
agents.description: Legacy single-agent UI recovery, replaced by the UI Recovery agent graph and kept disabled for reference. It infers a recovery task, has a GUI agent carry it out and sets the continuation.

arguments.name: task_name
arguments.description: Name of the task being recovered.

arguments.name: platform
arguments.description: Execution platform where the task runs.

arguments.name: os
arguments.description: Operating system where recovery is happening.

arguments.name: variables
arguments.description: Runtime variables relevant to the task.

arguments.name: ui_log
arguments.description: Ordered UI execution history leading up to the failure.

arguments.name: errored_act
arguments.description: Structured information about the action that failed.

arguments.name: model
arguments.description: Process model, in BPMN XML or another textual format, whose task ids are the model event ids that model_event_id refers to.

fields.name: result
fields.description: Summary of the recovery execution result.

fields.name: success
fields.description: Indicates if the recovery was successful.

fields.name: process_finished
fields.description: Whether the recovery completed the rest of the process, as set with `set_continuation`.

fields.name: continue_from_model_event_id
fields.description: The model event id (a task id of `model`) the robot runs next, as set with `set_continuation`; null when the process is finished or the recovery failed.

fields.name: loop_iteration
fields.description: 0-based passes of the loops enclosing that task, outermost first, as set with `set_continuation`; [] when there is none.

agents.name: UI Standalone UITARS
agents.description: Recovers the UI by writing UI-TARS actions as text, which its parser reads and runs on the robot's desktop.

agents.name: Tooled GuiAgent
agents.description: Recovers the UI by acting on the robot's desktop through action tools, each returning a fresh screenshot.

agents.name: Continuation Inferer
agents.description: Judges a GUI recovery against its task and tells the robot where to continue with set_continuation.

arguments.name: recovery_task
arguments.description: The task the GUI agent was given.

arguments.name: gui_summary
arguments.description: The GUI agent's summary of what it did and the screen it ended on.

arguments.name: goal_reached
arguments.description: Whether the GUI agent reported reaching the goal within its action cap.

arguments.name: gui_notes
arguments.description: The progress notes the GUI agent kept during the run, oldest first.

arguments.name: errored_act
arguments.description: Structured information about the action that failed.

arguments.name: model
arguments.description: Process model, in BPMN XML or another textual format, whose task ids are the model event ids that model_event_id refers to.

output_model.name: ContinuationReport
output_model.description: Whether a UI recovery succeeded, once `set_continuation` named the outcome.

fields.name: success
fields.description: Whether the recovery succeeded; agrees with the `recovered` passed to `set_continuation`.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: What the recovery did and where the robot continues.
